_note: MFX DoD robot — safe_motion exclusion zone configuration.
All dimensions in micrometres (µm) unless otherwise noted.
All coordinates are in ROBOT FRAME: Robot X = Hutch X, Robot Y = Hutch Z, Robot Z = -Hutch Y.
This file is read by SafeRobot.__init__ at instantiation time.
Re-run the setup script and reload SafeRobot after editing this file.

build_plate._note: Physical dimensions of the robot build plate.

_clearance_note: Safety buffer added to every side of each obstacle before path planning.
The robot path will stay at least this far from the raw obstacle boundary.
Set based on exclusion zone tightness, not just mechanical noise floor.
Must be > waypoint_coord_tolerance_um (10 µm) by a large margin.
_small_move_threshold_note: Maximum displacement allowed for raw coordinate moves (move_x_rel, move_y_rel,
Moves within this threshold undergo an endpoint check only (no full path plan).
Moves beyond this threshold are blocked; use do_move() instead.
Typical use: fine alignment jogs during sample positioning.

_note: Speeds written into robot INI config for setup-script-generated waypoints.
If omitted, the setup script uses Home position speeds as defaults.
WARNING: if speeds are missing in the robot INI, the robot falls back to
hardware maximum — unsafe for tight-corridor waypoint moves.
Maps task_name -> required_start_position_name.
Tasks in safe mode are BLOCKED unless listed here.
The robot must be at required_start_position_name (within position_tolerance_um)
before the task is issued.
This enforces a verified entry condition only — path safety INSIDE the task
is NOT checked. Document task safety assumptions alongside each entry.
For take_probe, use the fixed key 'take_probe'.
For do_task, use the task name as the key.

obstacles._name: Example fixture — replace with real geometry
_note: cx_um / cy_um: centre of the rectangle in robot frame (µm).
To specify by corner: cx = x_min + w/2, cy = y_min + h/2.
angle_deg: CCW rotation from robot +X axis. Use 0.0 for axis-aligned.
